title: Michael made to undress for examination by base personnel

tellings.quote: I had to be in a room with a bunch of men undressed

plain: In 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, after an experience he and other airmen describe as an alien abduction, an Air Force airman named Michael Johnson says base staff made him undress and examined him. He tells Michels he had to be in a room, undressed, with a bunch of men, and he tells it as evidence that the military took what happened to them seriously enough to check their bodies.
